scope: Single controlled factual-copying and correction diagnostic, own original foundation, fresh optimizer; not a broad foundation or general conversation run.
authority: User: ok keep going, following proposed factual-copying and correction test.
objective: 0.5 assistant/EOS CE + 0.5 narrative CE; each separately normalized.
selection: Highest development correct+EOS, then EOS, then lowest dev NLL among checkpoints under original 5% foundation-loss guard.
success: At least 60/80 test turns correct+EOS, at least 72/80 EOS, at least 24/32 counterfactual conversation pairs fully correct, at least 24/40 correct+EOS turns in each template stratum; original foundation NLL increase <=5%.
hard_stops: Any nonfinite loss, gradients, weights, moments or logits
Wall, work, memory, storage or disk caps
after: Stop after bounded run and inspect actual responses. No automatic continuation or promotion.
